# RP Guideline 3 - Keep conversation in character, and be mindful of OC/LOOC chat
Your character and You are two separate entities, this goes for everyone else as well. Do not treat the player as their character.
\n
- characters do not have to, nor should be assumed to, share thoughts with and opinions with their player.
- Low roleplay actions that have no regard for your character or setting (memes, Copy paste memes, direct riffs on existing media) degrade the experience for everyone.
- Avoid the use of netspeak, in most situations, that doesn't have a parsed replacement in the chat system.
- Be mindful of the amount of LOOC chat in public settings, and the nature of conversations had in dead chat.
- Our in game space is for play, keep it for that.
